package.name: g1_sim
package.description: Unitree G1 humanoid — Gazebo Fortress (Ignition Gazebo 6, ROS 2 Humble) kinematic-base simulation, mirroring go2_sim. Provides g1_sim.urdf.xacro (velocity-controlled ghost base + Livox Mid-360 gpu_lidar + IMUs) and the launch files sim_g1.launch.py (Gazebo + bridges + EKF + TF) and sim_bringup_g1.launch.py (full sim + distortion_corrector + SLAM + Nav2), reusing the autonomy stack (robot_nav, robot_lio, robot_safety) unchanged via the canonical sim/real topic contract.
